title: JUCJET EP31 PMR446 Walkie Talkies 4-Pack — 16 Channels, IP54, Camping
short_description: JUCJET EP31 PMR446 walkie talkies in a 4-pack with 16 channels and IP54 protection — for camping, hiking and group trips.
long_description: According to Amazon, the JUCJET EP31 set contains 4 PMR446 walkie talkies with 16 channels in the 446 MHz band. The devices are IP54 rated according to Amazon (water resistant) and have an average battery life of 72 hours according to Amazon. According to the product title, a Type-C cable, a USB charging station and earphones are included. The whole set weighs 1.46 kg. Please check the exact scope of delivery on the Amazon product page and the rules for using PMR446 devices in your country before buying. The actual range depends heavily on terrain and surroundings.
features: According to the title with USB charging station, Type-C cable and earphones
buying_angle: Handy for campers, hiking groups and families who want to stay in touch on the campsite or on the trail without mobile coverage.
